# Test fixtures

Our own `.lss` split files (LiveSplit format, `version="1.8.1"`), made up for testing.
They're generated by `generate.mjs` so the times stay consistent: the Personal Best is the best finished attempt (per timing method), and each best segment is the minimum of that segment's history.
To change or add a fixture, edit `generate.mjs` and run `node tests/fixtures/generate.mjs`. Don't edit the `.lss` files by hand.

| File                 | What it covers                                                                                                 |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `real-time.lss`      | Real time only. 5 segments, 6 attempts (3 finished, 3 reset, one reset before the first split), a pause, a custom comparison `Goal`, names that need XML escaping (`&`, `<>`) and a non-ASCII name (`Höhle`). |
| `game-time.lss`      | Real time + game time (game time = real time minus loads). 4 segments, 3 attempts.                             |
| `segment-groups.lss` | Native segment groups: `World 1` (segments 0–2), `World 2` (3–5), last segment ungrouped. 7 segments, 3 attempts. |
| `new-run.lss`        | A freshly created run: 3 segments, no attempts, no times.                                                      |
| `invalid.lss`        | Not a valid split file (truncated XML), for the parse-error path.                                              |

The format follows livesplit-core's own `.lss` parser and saver (required elements: `GameIcon`, `GameName`, `CategoryName`, `Offset`, `AttemptCount`, `Segments`).
